summary: Between 2025-03-03 and 2026-08-31, the CFPB published 1,200 complaints about Navient. Volume is steady (last 3 months averaged 400 per month versus 0 before). The most common issue is "Dealing with your lender or servicer" (54% of complaints), concentrated in student loan. The company responded on time to 100% of cases; 100% of closed cases ended without relief. Overall risk signal: Elevated (62/100). This is an exploratory signal from public complaint data, not a regulatory, legal, or investment conclusion.

regulatory.note: Live public-record cross-reference from FDIC BankFind, SEC EDGAR, GLEIF, and Federal Reserve enforcement actions. Public records only — not a verdict.
